title: Sending email when the sender can't send: Zoho blocks Send Email with the reason, TAVI opens Compose with Send enabled
label: RETEST PARTIAL vs ZOHO
env: TAVI staging-crm (NDC-Staging, owner; Zoho mail connection that can't send for this sender) · Zoho CRM org944965048 (Enterprise trial, admin whose email is not confirmed yet) · lead QA RT15 2806 green lead · nothing sent in Zoho

panels.caption: TAVI Compose Email while sending is refused (sendability can_send false): no warning, Send enabled
TAVI message dialog after the failed send: blue "Sent" chip next to the red "Failed" chip
Zoho, Send Email on a lead while the sender can't send yet: no compose window; "Email Confirmation Required — please confirm your email … so that you can send emails"

rows: Compose / Send Email when the sender can't send
Send Email is blocked before composing: a dialog explains why ("Email Confirmation Required … so that you can send emails"). No compose window, nothing to send.
Compose Email opens with no notice and Send enabled, although the sendability check already says can_send false; the user finds out only after sending.
How a failed send is shown on the record
Not compared: a failed send could not be produced in Zoho without mailing a real outside address (Zoho blocked sending before compose).
Emails tab "Not sent … Failed" + Retry (fixed); the message dialog still shows a blue "Sent" chip beside "Failed".
